en.headline: CFS finds bacterial counts exceeded in Junlebao pure milk samples
en.dek: Four samples of the one-litre product exceeded legal limits; the affected batch remains at the importer’s warehouse and has not entered the market.
body: The Centre for Food Safety said four samples of Junlebao pure milk (one litre per pack) tested under its routine surveillance programme contained bacterial colony counts at or above 10, exceeding the standard under the Milk Regulation.

The importer is Junlebao (Hong Kong) International Trading Limited. Investigation showed the affected batch is still stored in the importer’s warehouse and has not been released to the market. Other products of the same brand currently on sale are unaffected.

The centre has informed the importer and will temporarily revoke the earlier import permission for the product. It noted that elevated colony counts indicate unsatisfactory hygiene but do not necessarily mean the product would cause food poisoning.

zh.headline: 君樂寶純牛奶菌落計數超標 食安中心封存產品暫撤進口准許
zh.dek: 四個樣本菌落計數超出法例標準，受影響批次仍存於進口商貨倉，並無流出市面。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心表示，透過恒常食物監測計劃在進口層面抽取的君樂寶純牛奶（每盒1公升）樣本中，有四個樣本檢出含有10個或多於10的菌落，超出《奶業規例》所定標準。
進口商為君樂寶（香港）國際貿易有限公司。調查顯示受影響批次的產品仍存於進口商貨倉，沒有流出市面。現於市面上銷售該品牌的同類產品則不受影響。
中心已通知涉事進口商，並會暫時撤銷較早前簽發予有關進口商銷售該款產品的進口准許。中心指菌落計數超出法例標準顯示產品衞生情況欠理想，但並不表示會引致食物中毒。
